# Infinitum Corporation

> AI-powered services and blockchain-governed products for business, government and defense, with military-grade security for high-security civilians and businesses. Headquartered at 1629 K Street NW, Suite 300, Washington, D.C. Contact: info@infinitumcorporation.ai, (202) 729-9509.

Full product specifications and questions and answers: https://infinitumcorporation.ai/llms-full.txt

## Company

- [Infinitum Corporation | AI, Blockchain and Defense Technology](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/): Infinitum Corporation builds AI-powered, blockchain-governed software, secure communications and defense systems for business, government and the military.
- [About Infinitum Corporation | AI, Security and Technology Firm](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/about): Infinitum Corporation is a Washington, D.C. technology company building AI-powered, blockchain-governed products for business, government and defense.
- [AI Workflow Automation for Business and Government](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/capabilities/ai-workflow-automation): AI workflow automation for business and government: process design, systems integration, deployment and support, with human review and permissioned access.
- [Counter-Drone Systems for Military Organizations](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/capabilities/counter-drone-systems): Layered counter-drone defense for authorized military organizations: detect drones and swarms, decide with an operator in command, defeat and record.
- [Secure AI Infrastructure: Hardware, Cloud and Audit](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/capabilities/secure-ai-infrastructure): Secure AI infrastructure: AI computers secured from the chip up, an AI-native cloud, and a blockchain record of identity, provenance and audit.
- [Secure Communications: Encrypted Messaging and VPN](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/capabilities/secure-communications): End-to-end encrypted messaging, voice and video, a no-logs VPN, a private browser and private email for people, businesses and government.
- [Careers at Infinitum | AI, Security and Blockchain Jobs](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/careers): Join Infinitum Corporation in Washington, D.C. and build AI-powered, blockchain-governed products for business, government and military clients.
- [Genesis Drop | Infinitum Tokens Launch on Solana](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/drop): Every public Infinitum token goes live on Solana at 00:00 UTC on 1 January 2027. Register a Solana address to lock your early-viewer number.
- [Industries | Government, Commercial and Military Technology](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/industries): Technology and security consulting for federal, state, local and foreign governments, public and private corporations, and military organizations.
- [Insights | Technology, Security and Infrastructure](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/insights): Infinitum Corporation perspectives on AI, cybersecurity, defense technology and the infrastructure that connects them.
- [Investor Relations](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/investor-relations): Infinitum Corporation is a privately held company building AI-powered, blockchain-governed technology for business, government and defense.
- [Mission](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/mission): Turn intelligence into advantage: the Infinitum Corporation mission, vision and commitments for business, government and defense clients.
- [Press Releases and News](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/press): Infinitum Corporation press releases, company announcements and news about its AI, cybersecurity and defense technology.
- [Reflexive Capital Warfare™ (RCW™) Consulting](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/reflexive-capital-warfare): Reflexive Capital Warfare™ (RCW™) is Infinitum consulting for the contest over market confidence: how risk narratives move capital, and how to defend.
- [Security Research, Bug Bounty and CCW Services](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/security-research): Infinitum AI-enhanced security research, bug bounty and vulnerability disclosure work, and Corporate Cognitive Warfare (CCW) services by sector.
- [Strategic Partners](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/strategic-partners): Infinitum builds strategic relationships with technology providers across cybersecurity, cloud, AI and enterprise software.
- [Supplier Relations | Become an Infinitum Supplier](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/supplier-relations): Supply the components, services and technology behind Infinitum Corporation products and client projects. How to introduce your company.
- [Tokens](https://infinitumcorporation.ai/tokens): The Infinitum token economy: use a product, choose what you contribute and share in the revenue it creates, with every product token held in FIRM Wallet.
